messages:
Chris: Heads-up: staging promote blocked. Staging-e2e failing on auth refresh with 401s since 11:02 UTC. Looks consistent in this canary run.

Maya: Can you paste the failing assertion + headers?

Chris: ```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_refresh_flow.py::test_refresh_cycle
E AssertionError: expected 200 but got 401
E Response headers: {"x-cache-status":"HIT", "x-cache-ttl":"-1"}
```

Ivy: x-cache-ttl = -1. That signals the CI fixture cache returned an expired payload after the token payload change we merged. With CI_FIXTURE_CACHE=0 the job passed locally for me.

OpsBot: Promotion paused: failing check `staging-e2e` (job id 6845678922). Auto-rollback: OFF.

Maya: Two quick options for the release window: 1) revert token payload change (slower), 2) pin to last-known-good image sha256:77aa88bb and manual promote + evict fixtures. Pin is fastest.

Chris: I prefer pin for speed but we must schedule an unpin and a proper fix (TTL semantics) after the window.

Ivy: I can run fixture eviction after pin: `./ci/tools/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging --pattern=token_*` (est 2-3m). Also will add a CI guard to fail if any fixture response has `x-cache-ttl` < 0.

Maya: Oncall Chris, do you approve pin + manual promote?

Chris: Approve. Performing steps now:
1) `deploybot promote --image=sha256:77aa88bb --env=staging --manual`
2) `./ci/tools/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging`
3) `./ci/retry-job 6845678922`

deploy-bot: Manual promote initiated by Chris. Promotion queued -> in-progress.

ci-bot: Canary redeployed to image sha256:77aa88bb (job 6845678922). Link: https://ci.internal/6845678922

Ivy: Eviction finished. Retrying job now.

ci-bot: Retry complete. Staging-e2e green. All checks passed.

Maya: Creating follow-up RD ticket RD-10123: "auth-service CI fixture cache TTL regression" -> assigned to Platform, P1 post-release. Attaching failing logs and x-cache-ttl evidence.

Chris: Adding release-note snippet: "auth-service pinned to last-known-good image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; scheduled unpin after TTL fix (RD-10123)." Adding to release-notes/draft.

Ivy: I'll follow up with a small PR to add the TTL guard in CI and write an ops snippet for manual eviction steps in the runbook.

Maya: Ops runbook should include command, expected timing, and who to page. Also make unpin a tracked action item in RD-10123.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed by Chris. Release window unblocked. :tada:

Chris: Thanks everyone. Post-release we'll prioritize RD-10123 and schedule a 30-min maintenance to unpin and deploy the TTL fix.
